blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-no-zone-offset"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "10m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00+05:30", enforce = "vm" }

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock start is at +05:30, but no timezone is set, so the sandbox keeps the image's zone (usually UTC), where it reads 03:30; set [sandbox] timezone
